summary.text: TROMSØ FARVEHANDEL HAFA AS (966 378 034), a private limited company, is an active entity in Enhetsregisteret; founded 1992-11-09; address Storgata 81B, 9008 TROMSØ, Norge. Main industry is Retail sale of hardware, building materials, paints and glass (47.520); 8 registered employees; 2 registered sub-unit(s). Daily manager: Ole-Kristian Hagen-Olsen Henriksen; Board chair: Inger-Anne Henriksen; Auditor: REVICOM AS. Accounts for 2025 (period ending 2025-12-31): revenue NOK 12.58 m, operating profit NOK -2.19 m, net profit NOK 5.86 m, equity NOK 36.26 m, total assets NOK 41.20 m. Official website https://tromso-farvehandel.no/ is verified (the org number appears on the site); company-owned profiles on facebook.

statements.text: Works in retail sale of hardware, building materials, paints and glass (industry code 47.520); also registered for rental and operating of own or leased real estate. Stated purpose (Norwegian, from the register): Drift av Torgcenteret varehus i Storgt. 79-83, samt drift av Tromsø Farvehandel og parfymeriavdeling. Videre så driver Tromsø Farvehandel en engrossavdeling, i leide lokaler på Stokkevoldveien, som omfatter kosmetikk, rengjøringsprodukter og malevarer.
